description: Source code for the TaxExemption80GCertificate class, handling validation, address setting, total calculation, and payment retrieval for tax exemption certificates in an ERP system.

classes.name: TaxExemption80GCertificate
classes.description: Represents a tax exemption certificate with validation and payment management functionalities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs overall validation including date, duplicates, company details, address, total, and title.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Validates that the certificate date falls within the fiscal year if recipient is 'Member'.

methods.name: validate_duplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate certificates for the same donation if recipient is 'Donor'.

methods.name: validate_company_details
methods.description: Ensures company has 80G number and PAN details set.

methods.name: set_company_address
methods.description: Sets the company's address and display address fields.

methods.name: calculate_total
methods.description: Calculates total payments if recipient is not 'Donor'.

methods.name: set_title
methods.description: Sets the certificate title based on recipient type.

methods.name: get_payments
methods.description: Retrieves and appends membership payments for a member within the fiscal year.
